name: Agogo bell and shekere
desc: Highlife timeline percussion: the agogo double-bell tapping a son-clave-adjacent bell pattern at two pitches, cabasa/shekere shaker filling the eighths underneath — the metronome of a Accra dance-band night. Peak doubles the bell an octave up.

code.full: stack(s("agogo ~ agogo ~ agogo agogo ~ agogo").speed("[1 1 1.35 1 1 1.35 1 1.35]").gain(${gain}*.8).hpf(800).pan(.62), s("cabasa*8").gain("[.26 .16]*4").pan(.4)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("agogo ~ agogo ~ agogo agogo ~ agogo").speed("[1 1 1.35 1 1 1.35 1 1.35]").gain(${gain}*.85).hpf(800).pan(.62), s("cabasa*8").gain("[.3 .18]*4").pan(.4), s("agogo(3,8,1)").speed(2).gain(.25).pan(.7)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(2).play()
